name: igor-pro-bridge
description: Control a running Igor Pro instance via the ZeroMQ-XOP's CallFunction interface: run commands, read wave data, manage compilation, load experiments, and launch Igor Pro itself, directly from Claude.
long_description: v3.1.0: dialogs, screenshots, profiles and a more robust restart. `list_igor_windows` reads the texts and buttons of Igor's dialogs via UI Automation (replacing `child_texts`, which only worked for native Windows dialogs), the new `click_igor_dialog_button` clicks any button by its caption, e.g. "No" in a save question, `close_igor_window` returns the texts it closed, and the new `capture_igor_window` returns a screenshot of a window, also of controls which UI Automation can not read. `load_experiment` answers the old instance's "save changes to experiment?" question with "No", sends Quit/N again while Igor Pro does not answer and refuses with a clear error while the procedures are not compiled. The new `switch_igor_profile` quits Igor Pro, activates another user files folder by renaming the folders and relaunches it. The background task which rebinds the socket after `zeromq_stop()` of other code now survives opening an experiment. New dependency `comtypes` (run install.ps1 again); `colorama` is pinned, so a fresh install works again.

tools.name: execute_igor_command
tools.description: Run a command line in Igor Pro and return its output and error; prefer run_igor_code for more than a short command

tools.name: submit_igor_command
tools.description: Queue a long-running command and return a token for poll_igor_command

tools.name: poll_igor_command
tools.description: Check whether a command submitted via submit_igor_command/submit_igor_command_unattended has finished yet, and retrieve its captured output if so. Safe to call any number of times, spaced arbitrarily far apart.

tools.name: run_igor_code
tools.description: Compile and run procedure code as a ProcGlobal function via the bridge's scratch procedure file

tools.name: remove_scratch_procedures
tools.description: Remove the bridge's scratch procedures (INSERTINCLUDE) from the experiment again

tools.name: get_igor_symbol_info
tools.description: Look up a name with exists() and FunctionInfo() in ProcGlobal context

tools.name: run_igor_tests
tools.description: Compile and start a test run of IgorTest, returning immediately

tools.name: get_igor_test_results
tools.description: Return the results of an IgorTest run from its JUnit output once finished

tools.name: read_session_history
tools.description: Read back everything sent to Igor's history area since this bridge's capture started.

tools.name: get_wave
tools.description: Return an existing Igor wave's full data and metadata (any dimensionality; numeric, complex, text, or wave-reference).

tools.name: switch_igor_profile
tools.description: Quit Igor Pro, activate another profile (user files folder) by renaming the folders and relaunch it

tools.name: load_experiment
tools.description: Quit the running Igor Pro instance and relaunch it with a .pxp experiment file path as a launch argument.

tools.name: check_bridge_health
tools.description: Diagnose whether this bridge can reach Igor Pro's ZeroMQ server right now.

tools.name: check_compilation_state
tools.description: Report whether Igor's procedure code is currently compiled or uncompiled.

tools.name: reload_and_compile_procedures
tools.description: Reload changed .ipf files from disk and attempt a fresh compilation, reporting the resulting compiled state.

tools.name: list_igor_windows
tools.description: List the top-level windows of Igor Pro with the texts and buttons of dialogs, e.g. a modal dialog blocking the bridge

tools.name: close_igor_window
tools.description: Close a window or dialog of Igor Pro via WM_CLOSE or Escape (Enter, i.e. the default button, only on request) without changing the focus

tools.name: click_igor_dialog_button
tools.description: Click a button of an Igor Pro dialog by its caption, e.g. No in a save changes dialog, without changing the focus

tools.name: capture_igor_window
tools.description: Screenshot of a window or dialog of Igor Pro, also if it is covered, e.g. to identify an unknown dialog

tools.name: send_key_to_igor_window
tools.description: Send a key press to a window or dialog of Igor Pro without changing the focus

tools.name: get_debugger_state
tools.description: Read Igor's current Debugger settings (enable/debugOnError/debugOnAbort/NVAR_SVAR_WAVE_Checking).

tools.name: set_debugger_enabled
tools.description: Enable or disable Igor's Debugger, optionally changing individual sub-settings.

tools.name: restore_debugger_settings
tools.description: Restore Igor's Debugger settings to a previously-saved snapshot.

tools.name: get_environment_summary
tools.description: Summarize the live Igor Pro instance: version, loaded experiment, XOPs, included procedure files, data folders, Debugger settings.

tools.name: read_help_file
tools.description: Read an Igor Pro help file (.ihf) as structured, formatted text (paragraph style names preserved, e.g. Topic/Code1/Steps), without leaving any lasting change to Igor's help-window state.

tools.name: edit_help_file
tools.description: Edit an Igor help file with Notebook operations and verify its topics with DisplayHelpTopic

tools.name: get_bridge_version
tools.description: Return the version of this Igor Pro Bridge build that is actually running right now, plus the Python interpreter/package versions it's running with.

tools.name: configure_igor_launch
tools.description: Record the full path to the Igor Pro executable to use for launch_igor_pro_unattended/load_experiment, for this bridge session. Optionally set (or clear) a custom ZeroMQ port for the next launched instance to bind to and for this bridge itself to connect on.

tools.name: launch_igor_pro_unattended
tools.description: Launch the configured Igor Pro executable with the /UNATTENDED flag, always as a plain non-elevated child process, and wait for it to become reachable over ZeroMQ.
